_comment: Model presets so commands stay short: `vlm-eval run qwen3 tagging`. `run_name` is the folder under runs/ and the name used in reports; the rest says how to reach the model. `via` may be server (default, any OpenAI-compatible API) or florence/internvl/paligemma (transformers, add `checkpoint`). Your own models go in models.local.json — same format, gitignored, and it wins over this file. VLM_EVAL_MODELS points at a third file if you keep presets elsewhere.

qwen3._why: The bare `qwen3-vl:8b` tag resolves to the Thinking variant (its Modelfile sets RENDERER/PARSER qwen3-vl-thinking), which reasons before every answer and cannot be told not to — `think:false` is ignored because thinking is the renderer. For a boolean-VQA pipeline that is the wrong variant; name the instruct tag explicitly.

qwen3-thinking._why: The reasoning variant, kept as its own preset because it is a different model: measured at 52 images/hour against 269 for Qwen2.5, with 65% of free-text captions returning nothing but reasoning.
